name: Kujirata Tsukimi
source:
[url=https://vndb.org/c119567]Mira[/url]'s mother, she runs the coffee shop “Planet”. A widow whose husband passed away, she carries a certain sense of sadness. She seems to be having trouble with her daughter, who's in her rebellious phase.
